import os, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
from tensor_parallel import tensor_parallel_matmul
def run(rank, world_size, out_dim, port):
    os.environ['MASTER_ADDR']='127.0.0.1'; os.environ['MASTER_PORT']=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group('gloo', rank=rank, world_size=world_size)
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    B,K=4,8
    inp=torch.randn(B,K,requires_grad=True)
    w=torch.randn(K,out_dim,requires_grad=True)
    # broadcast same values from rank0
    dist.broadcast(inp.detach(), src=0); dist.broadcast(w.detach(), src=0)
    inp.grad=None; w.grad=None
    out=tensor_parallel_matmul(inp,w,world_size,rank)
    ref=inp.detach()@w.detach()
    maxerr=(out.detach()-ref).abs().max().item()
    # identical across workers: gather outputs
    lst=[torch.zeros_like(out) for _ in range(world_size)]
    dist.all_gather(lst, out.detach())
    ident=max((lst[i]-lst[0]).abs().max().item() for i in range(world_size))
    loss=out.sum(); loss.backward()
    exp_gi=torch.ones_like(ref)@w.detach().t()
    exp_gw=inp.detach().t()@torch.ones_like(ref)
    egi=(inp.grad-exp_gi).abs().max().item()
    egw=(w.grad-exp_gw).abs().max().item()
    if rank==0:
        print(f'out_dim={out_dim} fwd_err={maxerr} identical={ident} grad_in_err={egi} grad_w_err={egw}')
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    od=int(sys.argv[1]); port=int(sys.argv[2])
    mp.spawn(run, args=(2,od,port), nprocs=2, join=True)
